lieux.prompt: Small plain inn bedroom: a narrow wooden bed with rough wool blankets, a travel chest at its foot, a small shuttered window, a single candle on a stool, bare plank floor.

lieux.description: Place de village : fontaine de pierre, vieil arbre, maisons à colombages aux volets, panneau d’affichage.
lieux.prompt: Village square with a stone fountain, an old tree, timber-framed houses with shutters, a notice board with blank paper, early morning light, no people.
